column1: # Every line of agent-facing text that mentions a body, with what kind of line it is.
# Which lines: the lines (any case, also inside a longer word, and the plural bodies) of
#   - the string literals of the Go files under cmd and internal that are not tests (each value split at its line breaks; comments are not
#     delivered to an agent and are not looked at), and
# Format, one entry per line, separated by tabs:  key  kind  reason  excerpt
#   key     the path from the repository's top folder, "#", and the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the line without the spaces around it.
#           A line that is changed even by one word is a new line: it has to be read again and listed again.
#   kind    patch-first  tells to send a body again, but names the patch with a unique ending earlier on the same line
#           not-resend   does not tell to send a body again (reading, a description of what a body does, a field or key name, a commit message)
#           other        anything else; the reason says what it is
#   reason  why the line has that kind, from reading the line
#   excerpt the start of the line (ASCII only), so a reader can find it; it is not checked
# A line that is not listed fails the test, and so does an entry that no line has any more. To list a new line, read it, then add the
# entry the failure prints with a kind and a reason.
# A line that tells to send the text again without the word body ("send the whole article text again") is not found by this check.
